story: You are a researcher at the Mayo Clinic, conducting a longitudinal study called 'Preventive Health Insights'. You are collecting detailed health data from patients to better understand the factors influencing early detection and diagnosis of chronic conditions such as diabetes and hypertension. This includes information on screening methods, test results, patient demographics, and lifestyle factors to identify high-risk individuals and improve preventive care strategies.

variables.name: ScreeningMethod
variables.desc: methods used for breast cancer screening

variables.name: DiagnosisStatus
variables.desc: result of the initial screening test

variables.name: FollowUpTest
variables.desc: type of follow-up test after initial screening

variables.name: RiskFactorAssessment
variables.desc: assessed risk level based on family history and lifestyle factors

variables.name: SymptomPresence
variables.desc: presence and severity of symptoms related to the condition being screened for

variables.name: PreviousTreatment
variables.desc: previous treatments received for the condition

variables.name: FamilyHistory
variables.desc: history of the condition in immediate or extended family members

variables.name: GeneticTestingResult
variables.desc: results of genetic testing for hereditary predisposition to the condition

variables.name: LifestyleFactorAssessment
variables.desc: assessment of lifestyle factors that may impact the condition

variables.name: FollowUpNeeded
variables.desc: whether follow-up is required based on screening results

variables.name: RiskScore
variables.desc: risk score based on various factors
